support.title: Support
support.description: Every way of keeping this project running, in one place. Choose the method you already trust, the place the money lands and an amount of your own — or give a star instead. None of it needs an account on this site.

support.anyAmountDescription: Method, destination and amount are all yours to choose in the window that opens. Nothing is taken before you confirm it there.
support.freeDescription: A star, a follow, a bug report: none of these asks for money and all of them keep the project visible.

options.noAmountHint: This method asks for a gesture and not for money, so it has no amount, no currency and no limits. Nothing is recorded on the supporters wall.

options.pageHint: The supporter is sent here to finish the payment.

options.cardQrHint: Only if your bank gave you a payment payload. Leave empty to encode the card number.
options.cryptoAddressPlaceholder: Address, lnurl or Lightning invoice destination
options.amountHint: In whole units of the currency. Enter 0 to let the supporter choose.

options.orderHint: Lower numbers appear first. 0 keeps the default order.
options.activeHint: An unpublished method is hidden from the support page and the wizard.

options.railIncomplete: No destination of this method can take money yet
options.fieldsRequiredHint: Only the fields of the chosen method are required.
